decks.notes: This deck focuses on using ramp spells and mana acceleration to quickly bring out powerful Eldrazi creatures, such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. The control aspect comes from spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt your opponent's game plan. Karn, the Great Creator acts as a versatile utility card, while Nulldrifter and Sowing Mycospawn provide card advantage and board presence. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its big creatures while maintaining control of the battlefield through disruption and removal spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach along with cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to create a powerful combo that allows for repeated spells and mana generation. It aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and disrupt opponent's strategies with cards like Spell Snare and Unholy Heat. Mishra's Bauble and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide card advantage and help dig for key pieces. Urza's Saga can also help find crucial artifacts. The deck aims to control the board and win through a explosive combo finish.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of creatures and spells that disrupt or remove opponent threats. It uses efficient removal like Fatal Push and Malevolent Rumble to clear the way for threats like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Agatha's Soul Cauldron. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Scavenging Ooze to generate advantage and pressure the opponent. The land base is structured to support the aggressive strategy and provide utility with cards like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Urza's Saga.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to put pressure on the opponent. The deck includes disruption through spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also providing powerful creatures like Ocelot Pride and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. The deck also includes cards that provide additional value like Goblin Bombardment and Seasoned Pyromancer. With a mix of efficient removal, threats, and card advantage, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing cheap aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also incorporates burn spells such as Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment for additional damage. The deck includes powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to close out games. The deck aims to maintain board control with cards like Static Prison while constantly applying pressure to the opponent. It also includes powerful card draw and ramp options to ensure a consistent and effective aggro strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach to recur spells from the graveyard and combo off with Grinding Station and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to mill the opponent out or win with Thassa's Oracle. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble provide card advantage and graveyard manipulation, while Urza's Saga helps to search for key combo pieces. Malevolent Rumble and Unholy Heat provide removal options, while Mox Opal and Mox Amber help to ramp and fix mana. The deck's goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to win the game.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Static Prison to control the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to finish off the opponent as quickly as possible while disrupting their strategies, making it a high-pressure and versatile deck in the Modern format. With a mix of creature aggression, burn spells, and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing the UrzaTron lands and powerful control cards like Karn, the Great Creator, and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Relic of Progenitus and Sowing Mycospawn while also having the ability to wipe the board with All Is Dust. By using efficient mana ramp and powerful threats, the deck seeks to dominate the late game and secure victory through attrition and powerful combos.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats to overwhelm the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Agatha's Soul Cauldron to generate tokens and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician provides additional value through card draw and removal. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Nihil Spellbomb to control the board. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's aggressive game plan, with a mix of fetch lands and utility lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Boseiju, Who Endures.

This deck focuses on using artifacts and colorless spells to control the game, disrupt opponent's strategy, and generate card advantage through various ways such as drawing cards, searching for specific artifacts, or exiling graveyards. It aims to create a strong board presence with powerful creatures and powerful control spells while utilizing cards that benefit from having a high number of artifacts in play. The archetype combines elements of artifact and control strategies to create a versatile and resilient deck that can adapt to different matchups and situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Underworld Breach and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to recur artifacts from the graveyard and create loops with Grinding Station to mill the opponent's deck. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces quickly using cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber, while also disrupting the opponent with Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Malevolent Rumble. The deck aims to win the game by either milling out the opponent or using Thassa's Oracle to win on the spot. The inclusion of Urza's Saga also provides additional value and versatility to the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Underworld Breach in combination with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to create a powerful combo that allows the player to continuously loop through their deck, generating infinite mana and milling their opponent in the process. This combo is supported by cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to facilitate quick and consistent setups. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thassa's Oracle provide additional win conditions that can be easily accessed through the deck's strong card draw and search capabilities.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Breach combo strategy, which involves using Underworld Breach to cast multiple spells from the graveyard in quick succession. The deck includes cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble to enable the combo, along with powerful disruption tools like Malevolent Rumble and Spell Snare to control the game. With the ability to generate mana quickly and recur key spells from the graveyard, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of spells and ultimately win the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, with a mix of powerful burn spells and efficient removal to control the board. The strategy revolves around quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of creature damage and direct spell damage, while also utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Showdown of the Skalds to generate extra value and maintain card advantage. By maintaining a fast pace and applying constant pressure, this deck aims to quickly bring the opponent's life total down to zero before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talismans to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and World Breaker. It also utilizes control elements such as Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Karn, the Great Creator is included for additional utility and disruption. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures while maintaining control of the game through targeted removal and disruptive spells.

The main focus of this deck is to take advantage of Underworld Breach in combination with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to repeatedly mill through your deck and generate a lethal Thassa's Oracle win condition. Mox Opal, Mishra's Bauble, and Urza's Saga provide additional sources of mana acceleration and card advantage, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps to dig for combo pieces. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for the combo and win the game in a single explosive turn.
